[Key Information from testbed/langflow-ai__langflow-5272_2026-06-06_14-40-54/DEVELOPMENT.md]
- Environment Setup:
  - GitHub account and fork the Langflow repo: https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/fork
  - Clone fork: 
    - `git clone https://github.com/<your username>/langflow.git`
    - Add upstream remote:
      ```bash
      cd langflow
      git remote add upstream https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow.git
      git remote set-url --push upstream no_push
      ```
  - Core prerequisites if not using Dev Container: 
    - OS: macOS or Linux (Windows users must use WSL)
    - git
    - make
    - Python package `uv` (version >=0.4), a Python package & project manager by Astral (https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/)
    - Node.js v22.12 LTS and npm v10.9 (npm must be installed inside WSL on Windows)
  - Recommended Setup:
    - Use Dev Container in your IDE (e.g. VS Code) for easier setup ([Dev Containers docs](https://containers.dev/))
  - Initial environment validation:
    - Run `make init` to install backend/frontend dependencies, build frontend, and start application (runs `make install_backend`, `make install_frontend`, `make build_frontend`, then `uv run langflow run`)
  - Environment variable for anonymized usage data opt-out:
    - `DO_NOT_TRACK=true`
- Running & Development:
  - Run backend FastAPI service:
    - `make backend`
    - Backend runs on `http://localhost:7860`; health check at `/health` responds with `{"status":"ok"}` when ready
  - Run frontend Node.js service for development (hot reload):
    - `make frontend`
    - Frontend runs on `http://localhost:3000/`
  - Run documentation server with Docusaurus:
    ```bash
    cd docs
    npm install
    npm run start
    ```
    - Runs on `http://localhost:3001/` by default (if port 3000 busy)
- Testing Instructions:
  - Backend unit tests location: `src/backend/tests/unit/`
  - To run unit tests:
    - `make unit_tests`
  - Important notes on running tests:
    - Some tests (e.g. `src/backend/tests/unit/test_database.py`) may fail if running `make tests` but pass if run individually:
      - Run individual test file with pytest via: 
        ```
        uv run pytest src/backend/tests/unit/test_database.py
        ```
    - Other test targets exist (`integration_tests`, `coverage`, `tests_frontend`) but require additional setup not described here.
- Code Quality:
  - Run linting via `make lint`
  - Format code:
    - Backend: `make format_backend`
    - Frontend: `make format_frontend`
- Git and Pre-commit hooks:
  - To install pre-commit hooks:
    ```
    uv sync --dev
    uv run pre-commit install
    ```
  - When pre-commit hooks installed, run git commands within Python environment:
    - Example: `uv run git commit`
- Notes on managing changed files:
  - Some files (like `uv.lock`, `src/frontend/package-lock.json`) are modified by make targets; avoid committing changes manually
  - You can tell git to ignore changes for these files:
    ```
    git update-index --assume-unchanged uv.lock src/frontend/package-lock.json
    ```
- Summary of key commands:
  - Clone repo and setup remotes
  - `make init` to install and build
  - `make backend` to start backend server (FastAPI on port 7860)
  - `make frontend` to start frontend server (Node on port 3000)
  - `make unit_tests` to run backend tests
  - To run specific test file:
    ```
    uv run pytest src/backend/tests/unit/<test_file>.py
    ```
  - Pre-commit hook installation:
    ```
    uv sync --dev
    uv run pre-commit install
    ```
    and later use `uv run git commit` to commit changes
- Environments & runtimes:
  - Python version unspecified but depends on `uv` Python package (>=0.4)
  - Node.js version: 22.12 LTS
  - npm version: 10.9
  - OS: macOS or Linux preferred, Windows must develop in WSL

- Environment variable settings (variables to configure the project environment):
  - LANGFLOW_CONFIG_DIR: Directory where files, logs, and database will be stored (e.g., ~/.langflow)
  - LANGFLOW_SAVE_DB_IN_CONFIG_DIR: true/false. Whether to save database in the config directory
  - LANGFLOW_DATABASE_URL: Database connection URL. Examples:
    - PostgreSQL: postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/langflow
    - SQLite: sqlite:///./langflow.db (default example)
  - LANGFLOW_LANGCHAIN_CACHE: Cache type setting, e.g., SQLiteCache
  - LANGFLOW_HOST: Server host IP, e.g., 127.0.0.1
  - LANGFLOW_WORKERS: Number of worker processes, e.g., 1
  - LANGFLOW_PORT: Server port, e.g., 7860
  - LANGFLOW_LOG_LEVEL: Logging level, e.g., critical
  - LANGFLOW_LOG_FILE: Path to log file, e.g., logs/langflow.log
  - LANGFLOW_FRONTEND_PATH: Path to frontend build files
  - LANGFLOW_OPEN_BROWSER: true/false whether to open browser after server start
  - LANGFLOW_REMOVE_API_KEYS: true/false to remove API keys from saved projects
  - LANGFLOW_CACHE_TYPE: Cache type, values: async, memory, redis
    - For redis cache, required environment variables:
      - LANGFLOW_REDIS_HOST (default localhost)
      - LANGFLOW_REDIS_PORT (default 6379)
      - LANGFLOW_REDIS_DB (default 0)
      - LANGFLOW_REDIS_CACHE_EXPIRE (default 3600)
  - LANGFLOW_AUTO_LOGIN: true/false to enable auto login; if false, LANGFLOW_SUPERUSER and LANGFLOW_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD must be set
  - LANGFLOW_SUPERUSER: Superuser username
  - LANGFLOW_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD: Superuser password
  - LANGFLOW_STORE_ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLES: true/false to store environment variables in DB
  - LANGFLOW_STORE_URL: URL to Langflow store API endpoint
  - LANGFLOW_DOWNLOAD_WEBHOOK_URL: URL webhook for download events
  - LANGFLOW_LIKE_WEBHOOK_URL: URL webhook for like events
  - BACKEND_URL: URL of backend with trailing slash, e.g., http://localhost:7860/

- The .env.example file defines many environment variables crucial for configuring the server, database, caching, and authentication behaviors.
